documented: Tokens are valid for 24 hours; there is no refresh flow.
actual: Token expires in 900s and includes a refresh_token.
impact: Frontend must implement refresh token flow.

how_found: Calling /v1/listings?page=2&limit=2 returns offset=0 and ignores the page parameter.
impact: Scripts and frontend will infinite-loop if they rely on page numbering.

actual: Project prices are in Crores instead of absolute INR.
impact: Must convert Crores to INR before comparing or displaying.

evidence: Listing MAG-5000775 has carpet 94 and super 52

actual: 446 projects have total_listings that do not match the actual count.
